newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-PLATT WILL NOT MANAGE SOUTHAMPTON NEXT SEASON.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PLATT WILL NOT MANAGE SOUTHAMPTON NEXT SEASON.

text.p: Former England captain David Platt is set to stay with Arsenal as a player next season and will not be managing Southampton, the player said on Friday.
The 31-year-old midfielder said he had been interviewed for Graeme Souness's old job by Southampton chairman Rupert Lowe late last week.
But Platt said that, while he was impressed with Lowe's vision for the future, he was preparing himself for another season at Highbury.
"He (Lowe) did hint that the Board may choose to appoint a manager rather than a player-manager and I still feel I have a great deal to offer on the playing side," Platt said.
"I am now preparing myself physically and mentally for the coming season with Arsenal."
Andrew Dowler, spokesman for Southampton said: "I can confirm David Platt's statement that he will not be coming to Southampton as manager."
